parallels.text: Do not judge, and you will not be judged. Do not condemn, and you will not be condemned. Forgive, and you will be forgiven.
Why do you look at the speck in your brotherʼs eye, but fail to notice the beam in your own eye?
When they continued to question Him, He straightened up and said to them, “Let him who is without sin among you be the first to cast a stone at her.”
When they heard this, they began to go away one by one, beginning with the older ones, until only Jesus was left, with the woman standing there.
Why do you look at the speck in your brotherʼs eye, but fail to notice the beam in your own eye?

How can you say, ‘Brother, let me take the speck out of your eye,’ while you yourself fail to see the beam in your own eye? You hypocrite! First take the beam out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to remove the speck from your brotherʼs eye.

crossrefs.text: He who corrects a mocker brings shame on himself; he who rebukes a wicked man taints himself.
Do not rebuke a mocker, or he will hate you; rebuke a wise man, and he will love you.
You, therefore, have no excuse, you who pass judgment on another. For on whatever grounds you judge the other, you are condemning yourself, because you who pass judgment do the same things.
And we know that Godʼs judgment against those who do such things is based on truth.
Do not speak to a fool, for he will despise the wisdom of your words.

Brothers, do not slander one another. Anyone who speaks against his brother or judges him speaks against the law and judges it. And if you judge the law, you are not a practitioner of the law, but a judge of it.
There is only one Lawgiver and Judge, the One who is able to save and destroy. But who are you to judge your neighbor?
Why, then, do you judge your brother? Or why do you belittle your brother? For we will all stand before Godʼs judgment seat.

parallels.text: If you remain in Me and My words remain in you, ask whatever you wish, and it will be done for you.
Therefore I tell you, whatever you ask for in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours.
You did not choose Me, but I chose you. And I appointed you to go and bear fruit—fruit that will remain—so that whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.
Do to others as you would have them do to you.
In that day you will no longer ask Me anything. Truly, truly, I tell you, whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.
Until now you have not asked for anything in My name. Ask and you will receive, so that your joy may be complete.

crossrefs.text: If you believe, you will receive whatever you ask for in prayer.”
and we will receive from Him whatever we ask, because we keep His commandments and do what is pleasing in His sight.
The LORD is near to all who call on Him, to all who call out to Him in truth.
He fulfills the desires of those who fear Him; He hears their cry and saves them.
Call to Me, and I will answer and show you great and unsearchable things you do not know.
But seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things will be added unto you.
Then you will call upon Me and come and pray to Me, and I will listen to you.
You will seek Me and find Me when you search for Me with all your heart.

parallels.text: “Make every effort to enter through the narrow door. For many, I tell you, will try to enter and will not be able.
After the master of the house gets up and shuts the door, you will stand outside knocking and saying, ‘Lord, open the door for us.’ But he will reply, ‘I do not know where you are from.’
Jesus answered, “I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.
I am the gate. If anyone enters through Me, he will be saved. He will come in and go out and find pasture.
“Lord,” someone asked Him, “will only a few people be saved?” Jesus answered,
And indeed, some who are last will be first, and some who are first will be last.”

crossrefs.text: There is a way that seems right to a man, but its end is the way of death.
For many are called, but few are chosen.”
Then Jesus told His disciples, “If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself and take up his cross and follow Me.
For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for My sake will find it.
Let the wicked man forsake his own way and the unrighteous man his own thoughts; let him return to the LORD, that He may have compassion, and to our God, for He will freely pardon.
Do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what is the good, pleasing, and perfect will of God.
Leave your folly behind, and you will live; walk in the way of understanding.”
And there will be a highway called the Way of Holiness. The unclean will not travel it— only those who walk in the Way— and fools will not stray onto it.

parallels.text: Why do you call Me ‘Lord, Lord,’ but do not do what I say?
But He replied, “Blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and obey it.”
For it is My Fatherʼs will that everyone who looks to the Son and believes in Him shall have eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.”
For false Christs and false prophets will appear and perform signs and wonders to deceive even the elect, if that were possible.
So be on your guard; I have told you everything in advance.
After the master of the house gets up and shuts the door, you will stand outside knocking and saying, ‘Lord, open the door for us.’ But he will reply, ‘I do not know where you are from.’

crossrefs.text: For it is not the hearers of the law who are righteous before God, but it is the doers of the law who will be declared righteous.
Be doers of the word, and not hearers only. Otherwise, you are deceiving yourselves.
They profess to know God, but by their actions they deny Him. They are detestable, disobedient, and unfit for any good deed.
Since, then, it remains for some to enter His rest, and since those who formerly heard the good news did not enter because of their disobedience,
Later the other virgins arrived and said, ‘Lord, lord, open the door for us!’
But he replied, ‘Truly I tell you, I do not know you.’
Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from God. For many false prophets have gone out into the world.
Like them, he who overcomes will be dressed in white. And I will never blot out his name from the Book of Life, but I will confess his name before My Father and His angels.

parallels.text: I will show you what he is like who comes to Me and hears My words and acts on them:

But the one who hears My words and does not act on them is like a man who built his house on ground without a foundation. The torrent crashed against that house, and immediately it fell—and great was its destruction!”
If you know these things, you will be blessed if you do them.
But He replied, “Blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and obey it.”
If you love Me, you will keep My commandments.
Judas (not Iscariot) asked Him, “Lord, why are You going to reveal Yourself to us and not to the world?”

crossrefs.text: By the grace God has given me, I laid a foundation as an expert builder, and someone else is building on it. But each one must be careful how he builds.
For no one can lay a foundation other than the one already laid, which is Jesus Christ.
By this we can be sure that we have come to know Him: if we keep His commandments.
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; all who follow His precepts gain rich understanding. His praise endures forever!
So too, faith by itself, if it does not result in action, is dead.
As the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without deeds is dead.
Therefore, get rid of all moral filth and every expression of evil, and humbly accept the word planted in you, which can save your souls.
Pure and undefiled religion before our God and Father is this: to care for orphans and widows in their distress, and to keep oneself from being polluted by the world.

notes.title: Two ways: the tree and the chaff
